_comment: Pinned schema-bridge generator binaries from ley-line-open releases.
The DIGEST is the trust root, not the tag. A tag is mutable and a release
asset can be replaced under a stable tag name; the failure would be silent
because generated output looks plausible either way. This is the same
lesson as the OCI mutable-tag work (cloister-195e47) and the stale
generator pin it replaces (cloister-9170d0), where a v0.7.9 plugin
regenerated cluster.zod.ts green for five minor versions.
SHA256SUMS ships in the release too, but it is NOT the trust root: it
comes from the same place as the binary, so a compromised release supplies
both. These digests were captured out-of-band and are what a download is
Bumping: change version, replace ALL digests, run `task schema-bridge:fetch`
on one platform to confirm, and regenerate. A digest that does not match
